extracted.intended_audience: education researchers and applicants to the Spencer Foundation (prospective grantseekers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for researchers applying to the Spencer Foundation about the kinds of education research and related activities the Foundation funds. Emphasizes broad topical, theoretical, and methodological openness and lists supported funding types (research projects, training fellowships, field-building initiatives).

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation expresses a primary expectation that funded work be high-quality; no numeric scoring or formal definition is provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovative research
rubrics_metrics.description: We support...innovative research on education, broadly conceived.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovation is called out as a desirable attribute alongside quality; the page does not specify types or examples of innovation but pairs innovation with broad topical and methodological openness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education-focused and broadly conceived scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Our programs provide funding for education-focused research projects, research training fellowships, and additional field-building initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation funds multiple activity types (projects, training fellowships, field-building) and interprets 'education' broadly rather than narrowly confined topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Openness to questions, theories, methods, and approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Throughout each of our programs, we maintain broad ideas about the questions educational research might ask, the theories it might employ, the methods and approaches it might use, and the ways in which we might support it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should understand the Foundation welcomes diverse research questions, theoretical frameworks, and methodological approaches; no restrictive methodological or disciplinary requirements are stated on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for research training and field-building
rubrics_metrics.description: Our programs provide funding for research training fellowships and additional field-building initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit programmatic support includes fellowships (e.g., for scholars and journalists) and programs aimed at promoting collaboration and cross-disciplinary learning; applicants should consider whether their proposal fits those program types.
